scope: Retrospective development audit over original train and validation recordings only. Previously inspected data and informed model family choices; not a fresh holdout or a future-time/unseen-machine benchmark.
splitter: GroupKFold with shuffle=True, random_state=42; whole overlap groups, not individual readings. Same seed for every inner split.
selection: Fixed HGB and fixed smoothing window. Select threshold and persistence independently per procedure on pooled inner out-of-fold predictions only; existing precision-first recall constraints and fallback apply.
infeasible_fallback: If no point satisfies all recall floors, maximize the minimum capped ratio of achieved recall to each required recall floor, then precision, then minimize false-onset frequency, then recall. Disclose infeasibility. Do not change constraints or discard the outer fold.
final_refit: None. Paired outer-fold evidence only; no activation.
reporting: Paired pooled and per-group confusion counts, precision, recall, F1, false readings/onsets, availability, delay and shared fit/raw score/median runtime. No point adjustment, no old test access, no final refit or activation.
hypothesis: A fixed causal 15-ready-reading score median may reduce fragmented false alerts; it can delay or miss short events. No smoothing-window search or outer-result tuning.
